subject: Nimbus Retail — handoff & implementation roadmap
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@nimbusretail.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus Retail — handoff & implementation roadmap

Hi team,

Congrats — closed NW-2027-0411 (signed today). Quick handoff notes to get CS/Implementation started:

- Deal summary: Enterprise subscription for 12 months, estimated monthly billable tokens ~1.2B (predicted usage pattern: steady during weekdays, spikes during monthly promotions).
- Core ask: Deploy Redwood inference for personalized recommendation reranking + site-search re-ranking. Primary success metric: +8% conversion lift on personalized results in first 90 days.
- Timeline (customer asks): kickoff week of Apr 18, data ingest complete by Apr 25, internal QA + canary May 6–10, production cutover target May 15.
- Technical contacts: Maya Singh (PM) and Alex Torres (Head of Integrations) at Nimbus. Security contact will be Alex for VPN/KMS questions.
- Compliance: Customer has SOC2 and requires audit log retention policy; they asked about VPC/private deployment options (they prefer hosted with dedicated VPC if possible).

Attachments: SOW-v1.pdf (terms we agreed), Implementation-Checklist.xlsx (initial milestones).

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Assign primary CS owner and PM from Redwood.
2) Confirm a 60-90 minute kickoff with Nimbus w/ stakeholders (they prefer Apr 19–21 window).
3) Flag any blockers around infra/VPC/compliance before kickoff.

Laura — can you pick this up as primary owner? Sergio, please stay looped for infra/ops handoff and auto-scaling config.

Thanks — I will leave pricing/contract questions to billing if they come up.

- Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

Subject: Re: Nimbus Retail — handoff & implementation roadmap

Thanks Vanessa — congrats to the team. Happy to own this. A few clarifying questions ahead of kickoff so we can make the first session productive:

- Ingest: will Nimbus push full product catalog + event stream, or do they expect Redwood to pull via API? If push, do they have SFTP or an object store (S3/GCS) we should prepare for?
- Model expectations: are they planning to use the curated reranking model we provided, or request a custom finetune/embedding configuration?
- Security: they mentioned SOC2 and VPC — do we need to scope Dedicated or is a hosted VPC option sufficient for them? Any legal notes from procurement that affect data residency?
- Success criteria: Vanessa listed conversion lift; we should capture the baseline metrics and the reporting cadence (weekly during rollout?).

Proposed immediate plan:
1) Intake form (internal) — link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3nimbus-implementation — please fill before Apr 15 if possible.
2) Kickoff meeting (60–75 min) — propose Apr 19 at 10:00am PT or Apr 20 at 11:00am PT.
3) Tech prep window Apr 19–25: secure connectivity (VPN or private peering), sample data transfer, and schema validation.

Can Maya/Alex confirm preferred kickoff slot and whether they will provide sample data via S3 or SFTP?

I will attach our standard implementation runbook after this note and block time on calendar once the slot is confirmed.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Nimbus Retail — handoff & implementation roadmap

Thanks Vanessa and Laura — excited to get moving. Quick answers to Laura's questions:

- Data flow: We plan to push product catalog + weekly full export and a near-real-time event stream for user interactions. Primary delivery will be S3 (us-west-2). We can provide temporary S3 credentials for the intake.
- Models: We want to start with Redwood's curated reranking model. We'll evaluate finetuning after the initial 8-week window.
- Security/VPC: Preferred: hosted with dedicated VPC and audit logging enabled. We need clarification on how audit logs are retained and whether logs can be exported to our SIEM (Splunk).
- Baseline metrics: Conversion rate on search results currently 3.2% (30-day baseline). We'll provide access to Google Analytics dashboard for measurement.

Kickoff availability: Apr 19 at 10:00am PT works for us. Alex will be point for integrations and will join the kickoff.

Attachments: Nimbus-Security-Contact.vcf (Alex Torres). I'll drop sample S3 manifest and a short data schema in a shared folder by EOD.

- Maya
Maya Singh
Product Manager, Nimbus Retail
maya.singh@nimbusretail.com

Thanks — looping in operational notes and preliminary owner list.

On Mon, Apr 11, 2027 at 10:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Vanessa — congrats to the team. Happy to own this. A few clarifying questions ahead of kickoff so we can make the first session productive:
>
> - Ingest: will Nimbus push full product catalog + event stream, or do they expect Redwood to pull via API? If push, do they have SFTP or an object store (S3/GCS) we should prepare for?

Notes from ops:
- Owner assignment: Laura Bennett — CS lead and primary PM. Sergio Alvarez — infra/ops escalation and scaling lead. Engineering onboarding (short-term) will be assigned to Dev Patel for initial data validation and to Marcus Lin for model config tuning.
- Infra approach: we'll provision a dedicated VPC host group in us-west-2 for the account and enable audit-log export to a secure bucket. Need to confirm whether Nimbus wants logs streamed to their Splunk (we support secure log forwarding; requires customer whitelist).
- Canary plan: 10% traffic cutover for two weeks, monitor latency/quality, then 50% then full. Autoscaling policy: start with 2x baseline GPU capacity and set target latency p95 < 180ms.
- Blockers: Legal needs to approve the SOW redline re: data retention (I flagged clause 6.2). Recommend we ask Legal to start review concurrently.

I'll prepare an internal kickoff checklist and share the calendar invite for Apr 19 10:00am PT.

- Sergio
